text: In the middle of a bitter custody battle, Yoshimi Matsubara [rents a rundown apartment|trigger|making a new home] for herself and her six-year-old daughter Ikuko, where a leak in the ceiling slowly worsens and the superintendent does nothing. [A child's red schoolbag keeps coming back|rules|nothing can stop it] however often she throws it away, and glimpses of a little girl stir memories of [being abandoned at kindergarten as a child|wrong|abandonment and rejection]. She learns of Mitsuko, a girl who went missing a year earlier from the empty flat directly above, and [the water keeps coming|images|water and drowning].
